sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Technology remain dominant sustained leaders, while defensive rotation emerges as Consumer Defensive advances and Healthcare slips.

Energy continues to pace the market as the preeminent leader with a 0.967 momentum score, joined by Technology (0.800) in sustaining top-three ranks across one-, three-, and six-month horizons. Market breadth remains tight, however, with only 2 of 11 groups maintaining all-green status across all timeframes.

Rotation shows defensive positioning gaining selective traction. Consumer Defensive advanced one spot to rank 5 with 0.617 momentum, while Communication Services edged up to rank 7 (0.533 momentum). Meanwhile, laggards remain deeply entrenched, led by Consumer Cyclical at rank 11 (0.283 momentum) and Real Estate at rank 9 (0.233 momentum).

## Strength
- **Tight Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors are all-green across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD: Energy (momentum 0.967) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.617).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Energy (rank 1 YTD) and Technology (rank 2 YTD, momentum 0.800) hold sustained top-three ranks across one-, three-, and six-month windows.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Advancers:** Consumer Defensive improved +1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.617), and Communication Services gained +1 spot to reach rank 7 (momentum 0.533).
- **Decliners:** Financials slipped -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.350), while Industrials stagnate at a matching 0.350 momentum despite holding rank 4.
- **Deep Laggards:** Real Estate (0.233 momentum, rank 9), Consumer Cyclical (0.283 momentum, rank 11), and Utilities (0.300 momentum, rank 10) anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare Fading:** Despite maintaining upper-half momentum at 0.600, Healthcare dropped -1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 6, flashing an early-warning signal of deteriorating rank against strong momentum.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and commodity-linked sectors command absolute market leadership, while defensive consumer staples and credit are rotating higher against sharp drops in materials and aerospace.

Energy remains the dominant force across US industries, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holding the market's top momentum score (1.000, rank 1 YTD) alongside Oil & Gas Integrated (0.928) and Marine Shipping (0.902). Sustained multi-month strength is heavily concentrated in energy and hardware distribution, while 23 of 144 groups maintain all-green performance across all tracked time horizons.

Short-term rotation is favoring select healthcare and defensive niches, highlighted by Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic vaulting 33 spots over 5 sessions, alongside gains in Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 spots) and Credit Services (+15 spots). Conversely, capital is fleeing Uranium (-24 spots, momentum 0.10) and Aerospace & Defense (-21 spots, momentum 0.33), joining deep momentum laggards like Mortgage Finance (0.013) and Airports & Air Services (0.061) near the bottom of the rankings.

## Strength
* **Broad Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads all industries with a perfect 1.000 momentum score (rank 1 YTD), followed closely by Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.928) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.868), with all three holding all-green status across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD windows.
* **Sustained Multi-Month Leadership:** Beyond energy, industries showing durable strength (top 36 rank over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons) include Marine Shipping (momentum 0.902), Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.852), Copper (momentum 0.84), and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.83).
* **Overall Market Breadth:** 23 of 144 tracked industry groups are currently all-green, also featuring non-energy leaders such as Shell Companies (momentum 0.84) and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.82).

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic climbed 33 positions to rank 83 (momentum 0.55), while Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries advanced 16 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.71) and Credit Services gained 15 spots to rank 81 (momentum 0.72).
* **Sharpest 5-Day Declines:** Uranium plunged 24 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.10), Aerospace & Defense fell 21 spots to rank 93 (momentum 0.33), and Silver dropped 17 spots to rank 43 (momentum 0.46).
* **Momentum Floor:** Severe absolute weakness remains anchored in Mortgage Finance (0.013 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Airports & Air Services (0.061 momentum, rank 141 YTD), and Advertising Agencies (0.071 momentum, rank 144 YTD).

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum Leaders:** Several groups with solid momentum are showing short-term fatigue, led by Scientific & Technical Instruments (momentum 0.66, down 6 spots in 5 days) and Electronic Components (momentum 0.67, down 5 spots in 5 days), along with Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.63, down 5 spots).
* **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Early rank improvements are appearing in beaten-down groups, including Grocery Stores (up 9 spots in 5 days, momentum 0.46), Information Technology Services (up 8 spots, momentum 0.47), and Consulting Services (up 7 spots, momentum 0.34).
